version.label: Scient Docs complete corpus preview
version.appliesTo: Unreleased Help candidate based on current Scient Desktop main plus documentation PR #197; not a stable release

publication.releaseTrigger: A reviewed desktop release plus a website manifest PR selecting its exact Help source revision
publication.correctionTrigger: A merged desktop Help correction plus a dependent website manifest PR; no desktop binary release is required
publication.failureMode: The build fails closed and the previously deployed Docs remain live; CI and preview checks expose the failed source pin
publication.rollback: Revert the website manifest pin or the website publishing change; canonical desktop Help is never rewritten by rollback
